newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamanouchi shares rise on earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Yamanouchi shares rise on earnings forecast.

text.p: Shares in Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical Co Ltd climbed on Wednesday, briefly revisiting their prior high for calendar 1997, supported by a bright earnings forecast for 1997/98, traders said.
The share price rose to 2,610, matching the 1997 high marked on February 18, before retracing to 2,580, up 20 yen, at 0333 GMT.
Volume was 2.878 million shares, making Yamanouchi the 10th most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Yamanouchi said on Wednesday that its parent current profit was likely to reach a record 66.5 billion yen in 1997/98, up from 65 billion yen forecast for 1996/97.
